olivia: Heads-up — we started a canary to enforce server-preferred cipher order on the regional proxies. EU canary looked fine, APAC saw a spike in TLS session-resume failures. Rolled back APAC change for now. Anyone see an obvious cause? :thinking:

max: Did you only change preference order or also remove suites?

olivia: Only switched to server-preferred and reordered (ECDHE+CHACHA top, AES-GCM after). No removals.

kevin: Can you paste TLS logs from the APAC proxy? Suspect session ticket decrypts failing.

olivia: Snippet from proxy error log:```
2026-03-22T10:14:03Z WARN tls-handshake: session_resumption_failed client_ip=10.12.5.4 reason="session ticket decrypt failed: kms:AccessDenied" ticket_id=ab12ef
2026-03-22T10:14:03Z DEBUG keystore: decrypt_request key=proxy-session-ticket role=proxy-keystore-reader status=403
```

kevin: KMS AccessDenied on decrypt. Did we prune RBAC last night?

max: Yes — I approved a policy prune for keystore service accounts in APAC, scoped to env=prod only. Could be too strict for the canary SA which uses older binding.

sarah: If KMS returns AccessDenied, proxy falls back to full handshake and resume failures spike if clients mix resumption modes. Need KMS + keystore audit logs to confirm. @auditor-bot can you fetch last 1h decrypt denies for key=proxy-session-ticket in apac?

auditor-bot: query accepted. returning summarized results...

auditor-bot: ```
2026-03-22 10:13:58 KMS_DECRYPT_DENY key=proxy-session-ticket principal=svc-proxy-canary-apac action=Decrypt reason=PrincipalNotInRole
2026-03-22 10:14:01 KMS_DECRYPT_DENY key=proxy-session-ticket principal=svc-proxy-canary-apac action=Decrypt reason=PrincipalNotInRole
```

kevin: Confirms RBAC. Two things to do: 1) Restore minimal decrypt permission for svc-proxy-canary-apac; 2) Surface KMS-decrypt denies in proxy SLO dashboards/alerts.

olivia: Quick mitigation — grant temporary role binding and re-run canary?

max: I'll create a constrained role allowing Decrypt on that specific key for the canary SA and add an audit annotation. Can push in ~5m.

kevin: Also add a negative test to keystore RBAC CI so future prunes don't remove the proxy decrypt binding without flagging.

olivia: For longer-term, should proxies rely on KMS for session ticket keys or use local ticket encryption and sync rotated keys via keystore?

sarah: Trade-offs: central KMS is single source-of-truth but brittle to RBAC changes. Local encrypt+sync lowers per-handshake KMS dependence but needs secure distribution and rotation. Pilot local ticket keys for edge proxies in APAC/EU could be worthwhile.

max: Proposal:
- short: restore decrypt for canary SA + re-run canary (max)
- medium: RBAC negative tests in CI (kevin)
- pilot: local ticket-key sync with KMS-wrapped keys and rotation (sarah + infra)
- monitoring: surface KMS_DENY metrics into proxy alerting + add Loki/trace link in dashboard (olivia)

kevin: I'll own RBAC CI change. Test simulates Decrypt and fails PRs removing required bindings.

olivia: Max, should I wait to re-run canary until your temporary role is live?

max: Yep. Will post when applied.

deploy-bot: NOTE: IAM policy change applied for role "proxy-session-decrypt-canary" to principal svc-proxy-canary-apac at 2026-03-22T10:20:12Z by max.

olivia: Re-running canary now. Initial metrics look good — session-resume errors dropped back to baseline after ~120s.

auditor-bot: Audit link: https://audits.internal/2026-03-22/kms-decrypt/apac?key=proxy-session-ticket

sarah: Action items logged. I'll open a short RFC for the local ticket-key-sync pilot including threat model and rotation cadence. Kevin to open RBAC CI PR. Olivia to add KMS_DENY alert to proxy dashboards. Max to shepherd temporary policy rollback post-pilot.

olivia: Filing incident follow-up notes in runbook. :white_check_mark:

kevin: TL;DR for postmortem — unintended RBAC prune caused KMS decrypt denies -> session ticket decrypt failures -> resume failures in APAC proxy canary; mitigated by temporary role + plan for local ticket-key pilot.

olivia: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/edge/ticket-key-kms-rbac-incident-2026-03-22
